recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 1960s album cover featuring a central oval-framed black and white photograph of a male vocal quartet, set against a vibrant yellow and orange radial sunburst background with bold, arched display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Arched title text follows the curve of the central oval frame
High-contrast black and white photo contrasts with saturated warm-toned background
Radial gradient creates a focal glow behind the central subject
Script-style secondary text balances the heavy block-style primary title
coreInvariants: Central oval framing for the main subject
Combination of heavy sans-serif and casual script typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of four men in an oval frame, centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 50% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central oval photograph acts as the primary anchor, supported by the large arched title above.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top arched title, moves down into the central photo, then descends to the script text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The outer corners are filled with saturated orange, pushing the eye toward the bright yellow center.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Bright yellow center providing high-key illumination.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep orange/red outer vignette framing the composition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black and white monochrome for the central photographic element.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background gradients with extreme value contrast in the black and white photo and black outlines.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy condensed sans-serif and casual brush script
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses thick, uniform strokes with slight vertical compression
Secondary title uses a slanted, connected script with a thick black outline
Text is arched or angled to create dynamic movement
characterSpecificRedesigns: Arched baseline for the top display text
Heavy black drop-shadow or outline on the script text to ensure legibility against the yellow
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact block sans-serif paired with a fluid, informal script for a 'showbiz' feel.

preserve: Thick black outline on script text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, blocky feel of the top title.
Captures the mid-century casual script aesthetic of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 1960s style album cover background with a vibrant yellow radial sunburst center fading into deep orange and red at the edges. In the center, place a large white oval frame containing a high-contrast black and white photograph of a four-man vocal group from the 1950s, dressed in sweaters and collared shirts, leaning on a railing.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, arched, bold red-orange sans-serif title across the top. Add a secondary script-style title at the bottom with a thick black outline and white fill, tilted slightly upward. Place small technical metadata text in the bottom right corner inside a simple rectangular box.

verificationChecks: Is the central photo strictly black and white?
Does the top text follow the curve of the oval?
Is the background a saturated yellow-to-orange radial gradient?
Does the script text have a prominent black outline?

adjustableVariables: Curvature of the top arched text
Subject matter within the oval frame

mustAchieve: Strong contrast between monochrome photo and color background

postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth radial transition between yellow and orange.
Ensure the oval frame is clean and centered.
Verify the arched text is not distorted or illegible.
Confirm the script text has a distinct 'hand-drawn' quality with a heavy outline.
recipe.reuseFormula: Radial Sunburst + Oval Photo Frame + Arched Block Type + Outlined Script Type = 1960s Vocal Group Aesthetic.
